TS006 bounded-loops

A loop carries a fixed upper bound, so a violation surfaces as a crash rather than as a hang.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "All loops and all queues must have a fixed upper bound to prevent infinite loops or tail latency spikes. [...] Where a loop cannot terminate (e.g. an event loop), this must be asserted."
NASA P10 Rule 2: "All loops must have a fixed upper-bound. It must be trivially possible for a checking tool to prove statically that a preset upper-bound on the number of iterations of a loop cannot be exceeded."
